title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.26613v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. translated_title: AgentRoboCritic：理解前沿智能体在机器人直接控制上的能力
translated_abstract: 诸如GPT-6 Astra这样的前沿多模态语言智能体已展现出通过底层动作（无需高层原语）直接控制机器人的强大能力。然而，现有基准测试仅报告回合级别的成功率，既无法展示这些智能体如何成功，也无法显示它们在哪里失败。在本文中，我们对前沿智能体在12个操作基准上的机器人直接控制进行了系统的动作级别分析。我们提出了AgentRoboCritic，一个基于意图的评论框架，其中策略智能体在执行每个动作的同时声明一个局部意图，而评论器则根据该意图评估动作的结果和失败模式。我们的动作级别分析展示了前沿智能体在机器人直接控制上的有前景的能力，包括从局部执行失败中的闭环恢复、跨多样场景的可靠语义接地，以及无需训练的强大零样本操作能力。
tldr: 本文提出AgentRoboCritic——一个基于意图的动作级评论框架，通过让策略智能体声明局部意图并由评论器评估动作结果与失败模式，系统分析了前沿多模态智能体在12个操作基准上直接控制机器人的能力与失败原因。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework where the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action and a critic evaluates outcomes and failure modes, enabling systematic action-level analysis of frontier multimodal agents' direct robot control capabilities across 12 manipulation benchmarks.
